investment_strategy: Barbell AI strategy sized for a risk-off tape: overweight low-volatility, cash-generative AI platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) and add smaller, high-upside positions in AI semiconductor enablers (NVIDIA, Micron) plus AWS-driven infrastructure exposure (Amazon). Enter positions in staged buys over 3-4 weeks to manage elevated VIX and rising-rate volatility. Focus on leaders with strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus, and direct leverage to secular AI, while controlling position size in higher-volatility semis exposed to export controls and supply chain risks.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Overweight AI platforms with selective semiconductor enablers; accumulate on weakness amid elevated volatility and higher yields.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Chosen for combination of lower relative volatility (platform leaders), strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus, and direct leverage to AI secular trends; high-volatility semis included at smaller weights due to momentum and tailwinds, but sized for export-control and macro risks.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Near-term risk-off with VIX ~22 and higher 10Y yields; expect choppy trading as AI capex, regulation, and geopolitics are digested. Secular AI demand, data center buildouts, and on-device upgrades remain intact—use pullbacks to build core positions.
